description:
Because:
- FxA moves shared code from fxa-shared to Nx libs under libs/shared.
- fxa-auth-server must load only one copy of the user-agent code.

This commit:
- Adds libs/shared/user-agent (@fxa/shared/user-agent) with the moved module.
- Ports the 32 mocha cases to jest and deletes the mocha file.
- Moves 6 auth-server callers; frozen senders/email.js stays on the shim.
- Makes fxa-shared/lib/user-agent.ts a 2-line re-export shim with a spec.
- Adds node-uap to the root package.json and the tsconfig.base.json path.

Closes FXA-14699
